quizName: DMV Practice Test #5 30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: If your motorcycle starts to weave while riding over uneven metal bridge gratings, what should you do?

options.text: Shift to a lower gear right away.
Ride in a zigzag pattern to cross the bridge.

questions.explanation: If your motorcycle weaves over uneven bridge gratings, stay relaxed and go straight across at a steady speed. Steering in a zigzag pattern is more dangerous than letting the motorcycle weave.

questions.question: What should you know about taking over-the-counter medication before riding?

options.text: It is usually fine because over-the-counter medications are weak.
It may affect your riding and should be done carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: It may affect your riding and should be done carefully.
questions.explanation: Many medications, including over-the-counter drugs, can affect your ability to ride safely. Talk to your doctor about how any new medication might affect your riding.

questions.question: What is the best clothing for a motorcyclist?

options.text: Clothing that protects you in a crash.
Clothing that does not stand out to other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Clothing that protects you in a crash.
questions.explanation: Good motorcycle clothing protects you if you crash, keeps you comfortable, and makes you visible to other drivers.

questions.question: If your rear wheel locks up while stopping on a road with good traction, what should you do?

options.text: Keep the wheel locked until you stop completely.
Release the rear brake and use only the front brake.
Release the rear brake and then apply it again quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep the wheel locked until you stop completely.
questions.explanation: If your rear wheel locks while stopping on good pavement, you can keep it locked until you stop. You can still control your motorcycle if it stays upright and travels straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A stop sign is coming ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign is coming ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols and warn about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: When riding in a group on a straight road, how should motorcyclists ride?

options.text: In a single line, one behind the other.

questions.explanation: A staggered formation keeps the group close while giving each rider safe space. Switch to a single line when turning, going around curves, or entering or leaving the road.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: The light is about to turn red.
The light is about to turn green.
Stop and wait for traffic to clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light is about to turn red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns that the signal will change to red soon. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: What does a plastic, shatter-resistant face shield do?

options.text: It is not needed if you have a windshield.

questions.explanation: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protects your entire face. A windshield alone is not enough protection.

questions.question: Before riding, how should a motorcycle clutch feel when checked?
questions.explanation: Before riding, check that your clutch and throttle work properly. The throttle should snap back when released, and the clutch should feel tight and smooth.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white signs with red and black markings that show traffic laws. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When other vehicles are slowed or stopped, what should a motorcyclist do?

options.text: A motorcyclist should not weave between lanes of traffic.
It is acceptable for a motorcyclist to weave in and out of traffic lanes.
A motorcyclist should ride in a straight line between two lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: A motorcyclist should not weave between lanes of traffic.
questions.explanation: Riding between stopped or slow vehicles is dangerous. Other vehicles may change lanes, open doors, or stick arms out. Motorcycles need the full width of a lane to be safe.

questions.question: When can a motorcycle pass on the right?

options.text: If there is at least eight feet of clear pavement.
By riding on the shoulder of the road.
By riding on the grass, if it is level.

questions.correctAnswerText: If there is at least eight feet of clear pavement.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle may pass on the right only if there is at least eight feet of clear pavement to the right of the vehicle being passed. Never leave the road to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: What is a good way to handle a tailgater?

options.text: Let them pass by slowing down or changing lanes.
Speed up to put distance between you and the tailgater.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let them pass by slowing down or changing lanes.
questions.explanation: If safe, change lanes and let the tailgater pass. Speeding up may cause them to tailgate at higher speed, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight. Wear bright, reflective clothing anytime you ride, day or night.

questions.question: What can cause motorcycle collisions?
questions.explanation: Following too closely, called tailgating, is a major cause of motorcycle collisions. Keep a safe distance behind other vehicles.

questions.question: Where are you most likely to have a collision?
questions.explanation: Intersections have the greatest potential for conflict with other traffic.

questions.question: What is true about motorcycle mirrors?

options.text: The mirrors provide a perfect view.
The mirrors do not show your blind spots.
The mirrors should not be used, except when parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: The mirrors do not show your blind spots.
questions.explanation: Motorcycle mirrors have blind spots like any vehicle. Always turn your head to check blind spots before changing lanes.

questions.question: What should you wear when riding during the day?

options.text: Bright-colored clothing to be seen better.
Any color of clothing because drivers can see you in daylight.
Dark-colored clothing to stand out against the sunlight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bright-colored clothing to be seen better.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Always wear bright clothing to be more visible to other drivers.

questions.question: How do you shift up to a higher gear?

options.text: Place your foot under the shift lever and lift.
Place your foot over the shift lever and push.
Use your thumb to move the lever.

questions.correctAnswerText: Place your foot under the shift lever and lift.
questions.explanation: To shift up to a higher gear, put your foot under the shift lever and lift it.

questions.question: What type of clothing should you wear when riding?
questions.explanation: Wear bright clothing to increase how visible you are while riding. Reflective materials also help with visibility.

questions.question: A motorcycle needs _____ attention compared to a car.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need more attention than cars. You must check your motorcycle before riding. Problems must be found before you ride in traffic or at high speeds.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT have a major effect on blood alcohol content (BAC)?
questions.explanation: BAC is affected by how much alcohol you drink, how fast you drink it, and your body weight. Age does not play a major role.

questions.question: What should a motorcycle passenger do?

options.text: Hold onto the rider's hips, waist, or belt.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold onto the rider's hips, waist, or belt.
questions.explanation: Tell your passenger to hold firmly onto your hips, waist, or belt. If your motorcycle has handholds, they can hold those instead.

questions.question: Which brake is stronger on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: The front brake is stronger than the rear brake. It provides at least 70 percent of the motorcycle's total stopping power.

questions.question: Where should a motorcycle passenger sit?
questions.explanation: Passengers must sit behind the rider and hold firmly onto the rider's waist, hips, or midsection. They can also hold onto handholds if the motorcycle has them. Never ride sidesaddle.

questions.question: What color are service signs?
questions.explanation: Service signs are blue with white letters. They show where to find rest areas, gas stations, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: How should a protective jacket fit?

options.text: Loose so it flaps in the wind while riding.

questions.explanation: Your jacket should fit snugly so it does not flap in the wind. It should not be so tight that it restricts your movement.

questions.question: If you ride in the left third of the lane behind a car, the driver can see you in their side mirror. What is a problem with this?

options.text: Most drivers do not check their side mirrors often.
Wind can prevent the use of side mirrors.
Drivers should not use side mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Most drivers do not check their side mirrors often.
questions.explanation: Most drivers look at their rearview mirror more often than their side mirrors. When following a car, ride in the center of the lane where the driver is more likely to see you in their rearview mirror.

questions.question: What should a rider do about blind spots on a motorcycle?

options.text: They don't exist if you have a rearview mirror.

questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots just like other vehicles. Always turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes. Make this a habit.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, let all crossing traffic and pedestrians pass, then proceed when it is safe.
